# SSuite Office - Software Made Simple

> My brother and I created our website with a single purpose in mind... to provide computer-users with free quality office software and applications without any restrictions attached. Our main philosophy "Pure Visual Simplicity" is the bases of all our software creations and design masterpieces. We specialize in software that is profoundly useful, pleasing to the eyes, and efficient to run on any computer system without any restrictive digital technologies.

> Our software is written in native Windows code, which is the same code as Windows itself. By using the WIN32 API {Windows Application Programming Interface}, our software doesn't need to be interpreted by another operating system like Java or DotNet to run, making our software compatible with past and future Windows operating systems; From Windows 95 up to Windows 11 and beyond.

> [Our Official Home Page](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/): Henk van Loo and Marius van Loo are the creators and founders of SSuite Office Software. Just a couple of geniuses giving people free software forever without any digital restrictions and any spyware, unlike Microsoft and Google e.g. BigTech!

### Important notes:

- Our applications have the smallest system footprint possible and consume almost no resources, making them the fastest running software available.

- We have no trial versions present, no recurring service or subscription fees for anyone to pay, and no registration of personal information is necessary. There is also no need for Java or DotNet on your computer.

- We are still the ONLY software company in the world that does NOT require a "Login Prompt" or "Account Registration" for you to use our Progressive Web Applications, Android Apps, or Desktop Software...

- Our online software also does NOT run in the Cloud, but directly inside your browser!

## Docs

- [SSuite Office quick start](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/Docs/SSuiteExcaliburOfficeReadMePDFHQ.pdf): A brief overview of many SSuite Office software features.

- [SSuite NetSurfer Browser](https://netsurfer.ssuiteoffice.com/SSuiteNetSurferReadMePDFHQ.pdf): SSuite NetSurfer Prometheus is a cutting-edge browser designed to offer lightning-fast speed, top-tier security, and unparalleled innovation with preinstalled extensions. It empowers you to explore the digital world freely, without BigTech watching!

-[Why use only RTF](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/resources/richtextformat.htm): We only support fully compatible document formats like the RTF (Rich Text Format - *.rtf) and the Excel spreadsheet document format. The RTF document format is compatible with any operating system (Apple Mac, Linux, and Windows) and office suite, unlike Microsoft's Word document format (docx/xlsx) and OpenOffice's Open document format (odf /odt).

## Examples of Our Software

- [SSuite Office NetSurfer application](https://netsurfer.ssuiteoffice.com/): Created from pure originality, engineered for ultimate speed, and backed by trusted security, this browser redefines modern browsing. Experience seamless performance and protection without limits on any device, no matter its age.

- [SSuite Office Software](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/software/ssuiteexcalibur.htm): Professional and comprehensive free office suite for students, home users, and office workers.

- [SSuite UltraCam Video Phone](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/software/ultracamvideophone.htm): A professional video phone running real-time video at 30fps, with a file transfer portal.

- [SSuite MonoBase Database](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/categories/database.htm): An all in one database creator, with ODBC connectivity, SQL query engine, and custom report builder.

- [SSuite WordGraph Word Processor](https://www.ssuiteoffice.com/software/wordgraph.htm): A professional word processor and presentation creator in one application.
